summary: WM Technology's subsidiary Ghost Management Group filed an 8-K reporting termination of its 113,692-square-foot Los Angeles lease effective October 7, 2026, about four years early, for a $32.4 million termination fee payable in 53 monthly installments from October 2026; the termination was contingent on the landlord leasing the space to a third party. Concurrently, the subsidiary signed a new 114-month Austin lease for 26,223 square feet, with roughly $14.3 million in aggregate base rent starting as late as February 2027 and a $1.7 million improvement allowance. Watch the cash drain and any going-concern or covenant implications from the fee.
